title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you have any more of those
I din’t make anymore. You here tomorrow? I’ll brig some more
And I actually realized I have a softball game today, so I probably won’t be around for the game
Ok, no I don’t think I’ll be there tomorrow
Thanks. I wouldn’t be terribly disappointed if it was rained out, but it’s fun to do either way 🤷🏼‍♀️
How many more games do you have? Working the weekend?
nice. I’m coming to the game Sunday, but as a fan
Lol. My friend is coming home for the week from London and bringing her Irish boyfriend. I thought he might think it’s cool.
